name: Cache Accelerator: fixed-interval x0 extrapolation (Wtl)
plain: Runs the model on a fixed rhythm inside a step window and predicts the x0 of the skipped evaluations from the last three real ones. It has no change threshold, so the speedup is set in advance. The prediction shrinks towards holding x0 when the recent motion reversed, and it keeps fine detail from a plain linear guess while taking coarse structure from the careful one.
math:
τ = continuous step index found by interpolating −log σ on the schedule.
follow r = clamp(⟨m2,m1⟩/⟨m1,m1⟩, 0, 1), m1,m2 = x0 slopes per unit τ over the last 3 anchors.
guess x̂ = x0_cur + r·(τ−τ_cur)/(τ_cur−τ_prev)·(x0_cur − x0_prev).
With two conds (cond,uncond): extrapolate uncond and (cond−uncond) separately, each with its own r, then add.
linear ℓ = x0_cur + min(t, cap)·Δx0, cap = clamp(1/(4‖Δx0‖/‖x0‖ + 0.5), 0.5, 2).
Final for 4D+ latents: ℓ + G(x̂ − ℓ), G = spatial Gaussian blur σ=2 latent px.
Skip when (eval index in window) mod cache_interval ≠ 0; needs 3 anchors, else runs for real.

props.architectures: Any model through calc_cond_batch; raises on non-decreasing schedules and on guiders that bypass calc_cond_batch
